title: Karta exporter scale test
description: DSX workload exporter under KWOK load. Vertical lines mark the run phases.

panels.title: Load Pods
panels.description: Pods in the load namespaces, from kube-state-metrics. The reference count.

panels.title: Exporter Pod rows
panels.description: dsx_workload_pod_info series in the load namespaces: Pods the exporter attributes to a workload.

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Exporter Pod rows / load Pods. 100% means every Pod has a row. Short dips during create and churn are normal.

panels.title: Workloads tracked
panels.description: Distinct workload roots with dsx_workload_status rows.

panels.title: Exporter memory
panels.description: Working set of the exporter container (cAdvisor).

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Time Prometheus needs to collect /metrics from the exporter. Yellow from 10s (50k budget), red at 25s (scrape timeout).

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Items waiting in all exporter workqueues. Should return to 0 after each change.

panels.title: API requests/s
panels.description: Kubernetes API requests the exporter sends, all verbs.

panels.title: Coverage: does the exporter see every Pod?
Load Pods vs exporter Pod rows
panels.description: Dashed: Pods that exist. Solid: Pods the exporter reports. The lines should overlap; a gap below is lag or misses, a gap above is stale rows.

panels.title: Missing and stale rows
panels.description: Missing: Pods without a row. Stale: rows without a Pod. Both should be 0 in steady state.

panels.title: Workloads by kind
panels.description: Distinct workload roots the exporter tracks, by kind.

panels.title: Workloads by phase
panels.description: Workloads whose dsx_workload_status is 1 for the phase. A workload can be in two phases, for example Running and Degraded.

panels.title: Pods by workload kind
panels.description: Exporter Pod rows by the kind of the workload root they belong to.

panels.title: Workload objects in the cluster
panels.description: Objects the API server stores, all namespaces. jobs.batch also counts the Jobs that JobSets create.

panels.title: Owner resolution
panels.description: Exporter Pod rows by how their owner chain resolved.

panels.title: Invalid observations
panels.description: Rows the exporter keeps from cache after a failed or expired verification (observation_valid=false). Should be 0.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Dashed: the container memory limit.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores used. Dashed: the container CPU limit.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Live goroutines in the exporter process.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Time for one Prometheus scrape of /metrics. Bands: yellow from 10s (50k budget), red from 25s (timeout; the scrape fails and series go stale).

panels.title: Samples per scrape
panels.description: Series the exporter returns in one scrape. Grows with Pods and with workloads times phases.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Items waiting, per exporter queue.

panels.title: Queue adds/s
panels.description: Items added per second, per queue.

panels.title: Queue wait p99
panels.description: 99th percentile time an item waits in the queue before a worker takes it: the exporter's own freshness delay for a change. Empty while no items are queued. Buckets are powers of ten, so values are estimates within a decade.

panels.title: Work duration p99
panels.description: 99th percentile time to process one item, per queue. Empty while no items are processed.

panels.title: API requests/s by method
panels.description: Kubernetes API requests the exporter sends.

panels.title: Client throttle wait p99
panels.description: Time GET, LIST and other request/response calls wait in the exporter's apiQPS/apiBurst limiter. Above 0 means the client limit is the bottleneck. Watches are not timed, so the panel is empty while the exporter makes no such calls, as in steady state.

panels.title: API latency p99
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of the exporter's request/response calls (GET, LIST). Watches are not timed, so the panel is empty while the exporter makes no such calls, as in steady state.

panels.title: Load Pods by phase
panels.description: Pods in the load namespaces by phase. Failed rises during churn, when KWOK fails 1% of Running Pods each cycle.

panels.title: etcd database size
panels.description: From the API server (apiserver_storage_size_bytes), so it works when etcd metrics are not reachable.

panels.title: API server memory
panels.description: Resident memory of kube-apiserver.
